name: Aozora Chizuru
source:
Occupation: Secretary

Subject: Political science and economics

Personality: The second daughter of the Aozora sisters, she hates to be disorganized and sloppy in her life. However, she is not good at controlling her alcohol and gets into a good mood easily, and her usual coolness disappears.
